name: ac-earnings-quality
description: Reading reported earnings for what they conceal: accruals versus cash flow, cash conversion and the working-capital swing, non-GAAP bridges and what they exclude, revenue recognition timing, restructuring and one-off patterns that recur, guidance mechanics and consensus behaviour, restatement red flags, and the written quality record. It analyses reported results forensically; it never accuses a company of fraud and never recommends a security. Use when asking "earnings quality", "accruals", "cash conversion", "non-GAAP adjustment", "revenue recognition", "channel stuffing", "guidance cut", "restatement". Not for the investment case (ac-equity-research), not for ratio interpretation in general (ac-equity-research), not for the reporting on the statements (ac-technical-writing).
